items.a: It's an operating system for Telegram growth. Instead of 7 different tools — one platform: neurocommenting, parsing, account warmup, channel map, content factory and analytics. All in one dark terminal UI.

items.q: How are you better than GramGPT?
items.a: Broader features (channel map, content factory, agency package), smarter AI (10 styles + A/B tests), cheaper entry (Starter from $49 vs $130 at GramGPT for a smaller set). And we don't make you pay for each module separately.

We take anti-fraud seriously. 7-phase warmup, Gaussian delays instead of linear, 1 IP = 1 account rule, anti-detection typing simulation, quarantine on suspicious activity. Guaranteeing 0% bans is impossible — Telegram constantly updates algorithms. Our job is to minimize risks.

items.q: Do I need my own Telegram accounts?
items.a: Yes. You upload .session files of your accounts. We don't sell accounts and don't store your passwords. Each account is bound to a personal proxy.

Autonomous 7-phase cycle: stealth (reading only) → light interaction (reactions) → social (joining channels) → engagement (first comments) → active → established → veteran. An AI persona defines the behavior style. The entire process runs without your involvement.

items.q: Can I try it for free?
items.a: Yes. 14 days on the Pro plan with no restrictions. No card required. After the trial — choose a plan or leave with no obligations.

items.q: Does it only work with Russian-language channels?
items.a: No. Channel Map covers 55 countries. The parser finds channels in any language. Smart Commenter generates comments in Russian, English, Kazakh and other languages. But the main focus is the RU/CIS market.

items.q: What if Telegram blocks all my accounts?
items.a: The Self-Healing Engine automatically detects issues and quarantines the account for manual review. The platform preserves all history and settings — connect a new account and continue.
Yes. 200+ API endpoints. Full REST API for integration with your CRMs, dashboards, n8n scenarios. Available on Pro and Agency plans.
The Agency plan was created specifically for this. White label, client management, invites, revenue share. Resell the platform under your brand and earn from every client.
